en: Leaves remote workspaces without an origin color until you enable it here.
Tints each remote workspace's sidebar row with a stable per-host color so servers are easy to tell apart. Your manual workspace color always wins.
Remote host names on duplicate titles
Leaves duplicate workspace titles as they are until you enable it here.
When workspaces share a title, shows each remote one's host after the title, leaving off the domain the hosts share.
